getBalance|Read a wallet's ETH balance on Base
getBlockNumber|Get the latest block number on Base
createPublicClient|Set up a viem public client for Base
createWalletClient|Set up a viem wallet client for signing
estimateGas|Estimate gas cost for a transaction
sendTransaction|Send a simple ETH transfer on Base
getTransactionReceipt|Fetch a transaction receipt by hash
waitForTransactionReceipt|Wait until a transaction confirms
readContract|Read data from a smart contract
writeContract|Send a state-changing contract call
getGasPrice|Fetch the current gas price
getChainId|Get the connected chain ID
signMessage|Sign a plain text message with a wallet
verifyMessage|Verify a signed message's signer
getLogs|Fetch event logs from a contract
watchContractEvent|Subscribe to live contract events
getBlock|Fetch full block data by number
getTransactionCount|Get an address's transaction nonce
simulateContract|Dry-run a contract call before sending
multicall|Batch multiple contract reads in one call
getStorageAt|Read raw contract storage slot
getBytecode|Fetch a contract's deployed bytecode
getEnsAddress|Resolve an ENS or Basename to an address
approveERC20|Approve an ERC-20 spender allowance
transferERC20|Transfer ERC-20 tokens
getERC20Balance|Read an ERC-20 token balance
estimateFeesPerGas|Estimate EIP-1559 gas fees
watchBlocks|Subscribe to new blocks on Base
deployContract|Deploy a contract using viem
batchRequests|Batch multiple RPC requests together
